chunks: He initiated creation most initially and commenced it originally, without undergoing reflection, without making use of any experiment, without innovating any movement, and without experiencing any aspiration of mind. He allotted all things their times, put together their variations gave them their properties, and determined their features knowing them before creating them, realising fully their limits and confines and appreciating their propensities and intricacies.
ai.seo_question: How did God create the universe without deliberation or experimentation?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this passage from the Sermon on Creation (Khutbah al-Tawhid) underscores the doctrine of Divine Simplicity, affirming that Allah’s creative act was an immediate expression of His Will and Knowledge, devoid of temporal succession or physical change. It serves as a foundational argument against anthropomorphic conceptions of God, emphasizing His absolute transcendence and omniscience prior to existence. This view aligns with the Mu'tazili and Shia theological emphasis on God's attributes being identical to His essence, distinguishing His creation from human-like processes.
